findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
Client may terminate for convenience upon 20 days' written notice. Contractor may not terminate for convenience. Fees for Services in progress at the effective termination date are not payable.
findings.explanation: Only the client can end the contract without cause, and you won't be paid for work currently in progress.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the effective date.

findings.quoted_text: Upon payment of the first milestone invoice, Client owns all rights in all Deliverables, including Deliverables delivered after that payment.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client after just the first milestone payment, before all subsequent work is fully paid.
findings.suggested_change: Intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for that Deliverable.

findings.quoted_text: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement is capped at USD 35,000, except that Contractor's indemnification obligations under Section 11 are not subject to this cap.
findings.explanation: Your overall liability has a cap, but indemnification obligations are excluded from it, exposing you to unlimited liability in those instances.
findings.suggested_change: The aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement, including any indemnification obligations, is capped at USD 35,000.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, only the client can end the contract without cause and work in progress is not paid; I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 20 days' written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the effective date. - Regarding the relevant clause, intellectual property rights transfer to the client after just the first milestone payment before all subsequent work is fully paid; I propose that intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for that Deliverable. - Regarding the relevant clause, indemnification obligations are excluded from the liability cap, exposing me to unlimited liability; I propose that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this Agreement, including any indemnification obligations, is capped at USD 35,000. Thank you for your time and flexibility.
